latentInfluenceContract.rule: Familiarity scales the tactical component only; it is not an independent team-strength or result modifier.

equalSideNeutrality.rule: At a neutral venue, identical teams with equal familiarity remain symmetric at every tested familiarity value. Every equal-familiarity row must also remain inside the neutral population bands.

relativeGapChecks.rule: A larger familiarity gap must not produce a smaller absolute response, and reversing the gap must reverse the measured effect without side bias.

zeroLossControl.rule: Segmenting a match at a nominal loss minute without removing a player must be bit-identical to the paired segmented control and remain within the normal baseline.

multiplePlayerHeuristic.rule: Use the same role- and zone-local mechanism for every missing player. Possession, xG and win impact must worsen monotonically with each additional loss; no score or win-probability modifier is permitted.

workload.empiricalDirection: Remaining players cover more distance and have shorter recovery between high-intensity efforts after an early dismissal.
workload.rule: Apply only a capped compensatory workload multiplier. Treat its magnitude as a heuristic and validate that 11 players is an exact 1.0 multiplier.

causalPathways.possessionAndPasses: formation support and local action execution
causalPathways.shotsAndXg: progression, local attacking density and defensive coverage
causalPathways.fatigue: capped workload redistribution over remaining players
causalPathways.injuryWithoutSubstitutes: same permanent on-field player-loss mechanism after departure; no separate empirical target
